cohort: 240 neonates (80 cases with pathological jaundice and 160 controls without pathological jaundice) admitted to the neonatal unit
finding: Hypothermia, cesarean delivery, breast milk feeding, and male gender were significantly associated with jaundice requiring phototherapy management in neonates.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was significantly associated with jaundice requiring phototherapy management in neonates.
